read_secret: read a secret value from AWS Secrets Manager by secret name
write_secret: write a new secret to AWS Secrets Manager with optional description and tags
update_secret_value: update an existing secret value in AWS Secrets Manager using PutSecretValue
delete_secret: delete a secret from AWS Secrets Manager with optional recovery window
rotate_secret: rotate a secret in-place or create-new-delete-old in AWS Secrets Manager
